Astra / Support

Here when you need clarity.

Help with the current Astra app and the upcoming 1.8 features.

Start a practical path

Open Paths, choose a starting direction and follow its guided practices. Save your reflections and observed results in the journal. Paths, decisions and records work without an account or Plus.

Explore your birth profile

Open Settings → Birth profile. Add an optional birth date, known or unknown time and city. The app calculates your free reading, natal chart and transits locally. You can edit or delete this profile separately from your journal.

Enable personal Today in 1.8

Open Today, add a local birth profile, sign in and explicitly enable personalization. The short daily message and four theme previews are free. Full details, Outlook and Compass require Plus. These features are coming in 1.8; the App Store currently offers 1.7.

Turn personalization off

In 1.8, open Settings → Personalization to withdraw permission and remove saved interpretations. If offline, the app retries server cleanup when you reconnect. Your journal and local birth inputs remain separate.

Use Outlook and Compass in 1.8

From Today, open Your outlook for weekly/monthly reflections or Compass to send a question. Compass does not automatically attach your journal or save the conversation to it. A signed-in account, permission and eligible Plus access are required.

Manage an Apple subscription

Open Settings → Astra Plus for subscription management or Restore purchases. You can also manage or cancel the subscription in Apple Account settings. Deleting an Astra account does not cancel billing.

Use an existing web subscription

In 1.8, sign in with the same Astra account used for the Stripe web subscription. Astra checks its current eligibility. Manage billing through the web subscription provider; an active web plan does not require a second Apple purchase.

Keep your records safe

Journals are stored locally for the guest or signed-in owner. Signing in does not upload or sync them between devices. You can explicitly move a guest journal to the local account workspace. Uninstalling the app may remove local records.

Delete your account

Open Settings → Account → Delete Astra account. This deletes the shared account and associated server data across Astra apps, plus that account’s journal on this device. Linked Apple identities require the in-app Apple confirmation. Other local journals are kept.

Control notifications

Open Settings → Notifications. Categories are optional. A personal daily notification in 1.8 uses an already saved reading, so delivery of a new personal message is not promised when no reading has been prepared. System notification permission can be changed in iOS Settings.

Privacy and terms

Read the current Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. Astrology and AI output are reflective context and do not guarantee outcomes or replace professional advice.

Contact support

For account, subscription, privacy or product questions, email anghel.developr90@gmail.com. Please do not send passwords, payment-card details or raw birth information unless needed for a specific support request.
